title: Scalar cup product naturality under pullback
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $X,Y$ schemes [def-pc-scheme], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$, $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$, and $t:Y\to X$ with $f\circ t=g$. Use scalar cohomology, its recorded derived-functor coefficient maps, its Ext-defined cup product, and its scalar pullback [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. For $F,G\in X.\mathrm{Modules}$, write $\tau:t^*(F\otimes G)\to t^*F\otimes t^*G$ for the normalized tensor-pullback comparison [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor], with tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. For $p,q\in\mathbb N$, $a\in H_k^p(X,F)$, $b\in H_k^q(X,G)$, one has $H_k^{p+q}(\tau)(t^*(a\smile b))=t^*a\smile t^*b$. No further coefficient maps or quasi-coherence assumptions occur.

source.place: Cohomology Tags 01F7, 01FD, 07MB, 0FKV; Modules Tag 01CD for the normalized tensor-pullback map. Official sources https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01F7 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0FKV

proof.text: Apply injectivity of scalarCohomologyExtEquiv. Use scalarCohomologyExtEquiv_map for the final tensor-pullback coefficient map. Unfold the Ext-defined cup and pullback and cancel the additive equivalences.

Exact-functor transport preserves Yoneda composition and degree-zero classes. Associate the three coefficient maps, combine their degree-zero classes using Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀, and replace their composite by scalarPullbackCoefficient_tensor.

Use scalarExtCup_inverseImage with the two scalar pullback coefficient maps. Postcompose its equality by Ext.mk₀ of the target scalar tensor coefficient. Ext associativity and the degree-zero composition formula give precisely the equality obtained from the goal.

Local searches of both library roots and DAG found moduleCup_coefficient_naturality and moduleCup_pullback_naturality in Sheaf.Paper.CechCupPullbackCompat; these require quasicoherent coefficients and IsModuleCupProduct rather than the scalar Ext-defined cup. lean.statement:
theorem scalarCup_pullback_naturality
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (t : Y ⟶ X) (ht : t ≫ f = g) (F G : X.Modules)
    (p q : ℕ) (a : scalarCohomology f F p) (b : scalarCohomology f G q) :
    scalarCohomologyMap g ((Classical.choose (module_pullback_tensor t)) F G).hom
        (p + q) (scalarCohomologyPullback f g t ht (@id X.Modules (F ⊗ G)) (p + q)
          (scalarCohomologyCup f F G p q a b)) =
      scalarCohomologyCup g ((tensorPullback t).obj F) ((tensorPullback t).obj G) p q
        (scalarCohomologyPullback f g t ht F p a)
        (scalarCohomologyPullback f g t ht G q b)
